assessment: The manuscript by Li et al., identifies the polyether ionophore nanchangmycin as a novel anti-fibrotic compound through a comprehensive chemical library screen. Given the lack of clinically available treatments for liver fibrosis, the anti-activation properties of nanchangmycin could represent a novel therapeutic avenue for the treatment of this disease. These studies pave way for future studies evaluating clinical efficacy of nanchangmycin and modified nanchangmycin compounds in the future.
